name: Tanjay IV
description: Tanjay IV was a powerful world located in the Core Worlds. During the Alsakan Conflicts, it was allied with the Galactic Republic's capital world, Coruscant. In 22 BBY, during the Separatist Crisis, Tanjay IV's Republic representative Nemrileo irm-Drocubac was part of Commerce Guild Presidente Shu Mai's plot to achieve the secession of a number of Republic worlds. However, for his doubts in Mai's leadership, irm-Drocubac was murdered in what appeared to be a traffic accident on Coruscant.
